ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced Frontend Developer to lead the development and delivery of scalable, high\-performance web applications using React and Next.js. The successful candidate will take ownership of frontend architecture, contribute to key technical decisions, mentor junior developers, and promote best practices across the frontend development lifecycle.

The role also requires hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools and the ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated code for quality, security, performance, and adherence to development standards.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, production\-ready web applications using React and Next.js, including App Router, SSR, SSG, and ISR.
* Lead technical discussions and make key architectural decisions related to component design, state management, and application data flow.
* Drive frontend performance optimization, focusing on Core Web Vitals, bundle size, rendering strategies, caching, and overall application performance.
* Conduct code reviews to ensure high standards of code quality, scalability, accessibility, and maintainability, including reviewing AI\-generated code.

* Work closely with backend engineers to define, integrate, and consume REST and GraphQL APIs, including effective handling of errors and loading states.

* Promote and implement effective testing strategies, including unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing using tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright.

* Keep up to date with developments in the React and Next.js ecosystem and evaluate new technologies, libraries, and AI\-assisted workflows for potential adoption.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Minimum 3 years of professional experience in frontend development.
* Strong expertise in JavaScript (ES6\+) and TypeScript.
* Extensive hands\-on experience with React, including Hooks, Context API, and component design patterns.
* Strong experience with Next.js, including App Router or Pages Router, SSR, SSG, ISR, and API routes.
* Good understanding of state management solutions such as Redux, Zustand, React Query/TanStack Query, or similar tools.

* Strong experience with testing tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright.
* Proficiency in Git and collaborative development workflows, including GitHub/GitLab, code reviews, and CI/CD practices.
* Good understanding of web accessibility standards, including WCAG and ARIA.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Exposure to backend or full\-stack development using Node.js, particularly for collaboration on API design.
* Experience integrating AI or LLM\-based features into frontend applications, such as chat interfaces, streaming responses, or prompt\-driven user interfaces.
* Familiarity with cloud and deployment platforms such as Vercel, AWS, or Azure.
* Previous experience mentoring developers or leading a small development team.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

SOFT SKILLS

* Strong sense of ownership and the ability to work independently on complex or ambiguous challenges.
* Product\-focused mindset with an understanding of the end\-user experience.
* Strong mentoring and communication skills, with the ability to provide and receive constructive feedback.
* Comfortable challenging design or product decisions and supporting recommendations with data and logical reasoning.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
 The PO operates at the intersection of customer needs, business priorities, and team execution, bridging daily delivery decisions with the broader product vision defined by Product Management.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Act as the voice of the customer within the team, continuously exploring customer wants, needs, and preferences – whether customers are internal or external.
* Develop whole\-product thinking by understanding the full desired customer experience, not just individual features.
* Apply design thinking and Lean UX practices to identify the right problems to solve and guide solution design.
* Know the stakeholders – balance the needs of customers with the expectations of Business Owners, Product Management, System Architects, and other teams.
* Engage regularly with Product Management to understand market forces, business drivers, and evolving priorities.
* Represent the end user's perspective in roadmap discussions, validating that planned solutions deliver real value.
* Assist with program backlog prioritization by collaborating with Product Management, System Architects, and Project Managers on sequencing decisions.
* Communicate the vision and roadmap to the team during PI Planning, ensuring they have the context needed to execute effectively.
* Own the team backlog end\-to\-end – ensuring it is always populated with well\-defined, prioritized work ready for execution.
* Guide and review story creation, ensuring stories are clear, properly scoped, aligned to product strategy, and written with a user\-centric voice.
* Prioritize backlog items regularly using Cost of Delay (CoD) and value\-based frameworks to ensure the highest\-value work flows first.
* Accept completed stories by confirming they meet acceptance criteria, definition of done (DoD), and quality standards.
* Collaborate with System Architects to make space in the backlog for enablers and architectural runway.
* Provide daily product guidance to the team, elaborating stories, resolving questions, and managing emerging priorities during iteration execution.
* Balance feedback from customers, stakeholders, and internal data – maintaining a customer\-centric lens while respecting capacity and business trade\-offs.
* Foster built\-in quality by monitoring progress against acceptance criteria, NFRs, and the definition of done throughout the iteration.
* Actively participate in all team and program events: iteration planning, backlog refinement, iteration reviews, retrospectives, team syncs, and PI Planning.
* Test benefit assumptions by collaborating with Product Management to define expected value, then validating through customer and stakeholder feedback post\-delivery.
* Gather qualitative and quantitative feedback through empathy interviews, Gemba walks, iteration reviews, system demos, and application telemetry.
* Share feedback and insights across the program – with Product Management, System Architects, and fellow POs through PO Syncs and program events.
* Continuously evolve solution design by feeding insights back into the Plan\-Do\-Check\-Adjust cycle, driving relentless improvement of the team's output.
* Product Management owns product vision, market strategy, roadmap, and program backlog.
* The Product Owner translates that strategy into team\-level execution – owning the team backlog, defining stories, and guiding the team toward high\-value outcomes.
* Engineering designs, builds, and ships – with the PO as their daily product partner and customer proxy.


**Qualifications**
* 3–6 years of experience in product ownership, product management, or Agile delivery roles.
* Deep understanding of Agile practices – Scrum, Kanban – with a strong product mindset and customer\-centric orientation.
* Proven ability to write clear, well\-defined user stories and acceptance criteria using behavior\-driven development (BDD) principles.
* Experience prioritizing backlogs using value\-based frameworks such as Cost of Delay (CoD) or WSJF.
* Skilled at balancing multiple stakeholder perspectives while keeping the team focused on highest\-value outcomes.
* Strong communication skills – able to engage effectively with customers, engineering teams, and business leadership.
* Hands\-on experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar for backlog management and delivery tracking.
* Familiarity with SAFe or scaled Agile frameworks is a strong advantage.


**Preferred**
* Experience participating in PI Planning, System Demos, and Inspect \& Adapt events.
* Understanding of Lean UX, design thinking, and human\-centered design practices.
* Familiarity with architectural concepts sufficient to support enabler story definition and runway planning.
* CSPO, SAFe PO/PM, or equivalent Agile certification.

**About The Role:** 




 We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded Product Manager with strong technical intuition with 5\+ years of experience building cloud\-native, scalable Enterprise SaaS products from the ground up (0 → 1\). You will own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle from discovery through launch, growth, and maturity for an API\-first platform that helps enterprises solve high\-stakes problems in fraud prevention, identity verification, and customer authentication.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of telecom infrastructure, identity \& security, and enterprise SaaS. You will translate complex operator\-network capabilities into compelling, developer\-friendly API products that help enterprises fight fraud, streamline authentication, and build trust with their customers. You should be someone who has lived through at least one full product lifecycle from MVP to Scale (or Sunset) and thrives in ambiguity, cross\-functional collaboration, and ecosystem\-level strategic thinking.
 



  





**What you’ll be Responsible for:** 



* **Product Strategy \& Roadmap** 
 : Define and drive product strategy, vision, and roadmap for our Enterprise API products. Position our APIs within the broader enterprise fraud\-prevention and identity stack to maximize relevance and stickiness. Define and drive product strategy, vision, and roadmap for Network API products aligned with GSMA Open Gateway and CAMARA API standards.
* **Strategic Discovery \& Ecosystem Thinking** 
 : Conduct deep strategic discovery, customer interviews, competitive intelligence, TAM/SAM analysis, and ecosystem mapping. Think beyond a single API, position the product within the broader enterprise fraud\-prevention and identity stack.
* **Product Metric Ownership** 
 : Own product KPIs end\-to\-end: adoption rates, API call volumes, latency SLAs, conversion funnels, revenue contribution, and customer NPS. Build dashboards using analytics tools, define success metrics, and hold the team accountable to them.
* **Agile Leadership \& Delivery** 
 : Lead agile squads (engineering, design, QA) through sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release management. Ensure predictable, high\-quality delivery cadence and clear acceptable criteria.

 : Evaluate and integrate AI/ML\-enabled tools into the development lifecycle from automated testing and code review to intelligent API monitoring and anomaly detection.
* **Go\-to\-Market \& Stakeholder Management** 
 : Partner with Sales, Pre\-Sales, Customer Success, and BD teams to build sales enablement collateral, conduct product demos, and support enterprise deal cycles.
* **Product\-Led Growth (PLG)** 
 : Drive Product\-Led Growth motions: self\-serve onboarding, developer sandbox, usage\-based trials, and in\-product analytics to reduce sales\-cycle friction and accelerate adoption.
* **Developer \& Enterprise UX:** 
 Work closely with UX/Design to deliver intuitive developer portals, API documentation, and integration guides. Ensure the product experience delights both enterprise decision\-makers and integration engineers.
* **Cloud\-Native Fluency:** 
 Collaborate with engineering to ensure cloud\-native architecture best practices, microservices, containerization (Kubernetes), CI/CD, observability, and auto\-scaling are reflected in product decisions.



  





**What should We look in you?** 




  





**Must Have Qualifications** 



* 5\+ years of product management experience building cloud\-native, API\-first, or Enterprise SaaS products.
* Should have BE / B.Tech \& MBA be from Tier 1 institutes
* Demonstrated experience taking a product from 0 → 1 (ideation through launch and scale).
* Lived through at least one complete product lifecycle: MVP → Product\-Market Fit → Scale (or managed a graceful Sunset).
* Hands\-on experience with strategic discovery: customer interviews, TAM/SAM analysis, competitive intelligence, and ecosystem mapping.
* Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies; experience as a Product Owner or equivalent.
* Track record of owning and improving product metrics (adoption, engagement, revenue).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to influence without authority across engineering, design and sales.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field. MBA or equivalent is a plus.



**Nice\-to\-Have** 



* Domain experience in telecom, identity, or fraud\-prevention ecosystems including familiarity with GSMA Open Gateway framework and CAMARA API specifications.
* Understanding of identity standards: OpenID Connect, CIBA, OAuth 2\.0
* Solid understanding of cloud\-native architecture: microservices, Kubernetes, API gateways, event\-driven patterns, observability.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled tooling in development workflows



  





**Why join us?** 



* **Impactful Work:** 
 Play a pivotal role in safeguarding Tanla's assets, data, and reputation in the industry.
* **Tremendous Growth Opportunities** 
 : Be part of a rapidly growing company in the telecom and CPaaS space, with opportunities for professional development.
* **Innovative Environment:** 
 Work alongside a world\-class team in a challenging and fun environment, where innovation is celebrated.



  





 Tanla is an equal opportunity employer. We champion diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

* 3–6 years of experience in product ownership, product management, or Agile delivery roles.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Tax
jobs.description:
Location : HYD/BLR/GGM
 



  





 Arcesium is looking for a hands\-on Product Manager to own and drive the evolution of our Tax Product for the Alternative Investment industry. This is a builder’s role for someone who can work closely with Engineering to translate complex tax workflows into scalable technology solutions—from requirements definition through production delivery.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who has personally built and shipped technology solutions for hedge fund tax operations. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience taking products or platform capabilities from concept and requirements through design, development, testing, and production, working closely with engineering teams throughout the process.
 



  





 The role requires a strong combination of tax domain expertise, product thinking, and technology execution. You should be comfortable understanding complex hedge fund tax workflows, identifying opportunities to solve them through technology, defining clear product requirements, and partnering hands\-on with Engineering to deliver solutions that are scalable, reliable, and user focused.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 



* **Own the product** 
 : Drive requirements, prioritization, and delivery for the Tax Product roadmap, working directly with engineering through the full lifecycle from problem definition to production.
* **Go deep on the technical detail** 
 : Translate hedge fund tax mechanics like partnership allocations, wash sales, tax lot classification, K\-1 processing, and regulatory filings (FBAR, FATCA, FIN48\) into precise specifications.
* **Engage clients directly** 
 : Handle client and internal stakeholder questions on tax product with the accuracy and timeliness the role demands.
* **Support the roadmap** 
 : Contribute to and eventually own the vision and roadmap for the Tax Product that is informed by market trends and the needs of Alternative Investment clients.
* **Grow with the role** 
 : This role starts as an individual contributor. Candidates who demonstrate strong independent delivery and domain command will have a path to leading the Tax Product team, earned through performance.



  





**What You'll Need:** 



* 8–12 years of experience in US Taxation, with hands\-on domain expertise in US Tax Compliance and Planning for Hedge Funds.
* Working knowledge of wash sales, tax lot classification (including Section 1256 treatment), K\-1 and investor allocation processing, and regulatory filings such as FBAR, FATCA, and FIN48\.
* Direct, verifiable experience building or delivering technology solutions for tax operations like platform features, workflow automation, or systems you helped design and ship with an engineering team.
* Ability to work independently and produce accurate output that holds up on subsequent reviews.
* Strong communication skills, with a track record of meeting client and internal commitments on time.
* An outstanding academic background and genuine interest in working in a high\-tech software development environment.

We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
 



 Financial technology is a high\-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status\-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities.** 




  





 We are looking for an exceptionally talented resource to join one of our cross\-functional product teams for an individual contributor role. This product team is responsible for building the core accounting product offering of our platform. This position offers the opportunity to define and design the next generation of products on our platform, which is used by some of the most sophisticated hedge funds in the world, and to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 



* Carry the product/feature from concept to creation.

jobs.description:
The ISO Underwriting unit of Verisk Insurance Solutions is hiring a QA Business Analyst as part of the team developing and supporting ISO’s Electronic Rating Content (ERC) product. As a QA Business Analyst at Verisk, you will be part of our Underwriting Products team, working closely with product managers and IT to enable success for our customers and drive the ERC product forward


  
* Ability to retain in depth knowledge of Verisk Rating and ERC Rating offerings
* Developing and implementing testing strategies, plans, and procedures for insurance manual updates for supported lines within ERC
* Identifying and reporting defects and issues to the development team and tracking them through to resolution.
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure that help deliver quality features with efficiency.
* Knowledge of API technology and API requests
* Troubleshoot issues and solve problems, identify potential process improvement
* Production support for answering questions around ERC product offering
* Ability to work independently and within Team environment
* Work with management to develop performance basis measurements and complete all defined responsibilities
* Completes all responsibilities as outlined on annual Performance Plan.

  
* BS/BA or equivalent with 2\+ years of experience in Validation, functional testing and Business analysis.
* Detail\-oriented and solutions\-driven QA professional with a mix of technical skills and strategic thinking.
* Strong knowledge of Excel, using its advanced functions (e.g., pivot tables, vlookups, data analysis) to organize, analyze, and visualize test data efficiently.
* Experience in creating test cases and test scenarios.
* Technical skills which include competency with development environments and insurance software products would be a plus.
* Excel in defect management by triaging, prioritizing, and collaborating with developers for timely issue resolution.
* Commercial lines admitted business experience
* Highly motivated self\-starter, with strong analytical, inter\-personal and leadership skills
* Polished communication, presentation, and leaderships qualities

  
**Our People, Our Culture**

For more than 50 years, Verisk has helped property and casualty insurers make smarter decisions about risk through AI\-powered risk modeling, advanced analytics, and technology solutions spanning the entire policy lifecycle. **ABOUT US:**  

As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
  
  

With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different \- in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
  
  

Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
  
  

We are seeking an experienced Technical Business Analyst to join our CapAssure team, supporting the complete lifecycle of our SaaS application—from data analysis and system configuration to quality assurance and production support.
  
  

You will analyze and maintain critical data assets, gather and interpret database information, and track client requests and deliverables for the Product organization. This role requires hands\-on technical expertise: staging SQL queries, applying database changes, and validating data and configuration updates across QA, UAT, and Production environments.
  
  

Your responsibilities include performing functional, report, and regression testing to ensure application quality, while serving as a key resource for business users requiring complex data analyses and unique dataset extractions. You'll apply these same capabilities to new client onboarding and ongoing configuration maintenance.
  
  

**What We're Looking For:**  

The ideal candidate demonstrates strong RDBMS knowledge, advanced SQL proficiency, and analytical thinking with the ability to confidently navigate complex data. You should be detail\-oriented with excellent problem\-solving skills, well\-organized, and comfortable managing shifting priorities and tight deadlines.
  
  

Experience with the full Software Development Lifecycle and enterprise\-class system testing is highly valued. Through this role, you'll develop deep expertise in complex private equity fund waterfalls and carried interest plans.
  
  

**What You'll Do:**  

As a Technical Business Analyst, you will bridge the gap between our Product organization, Client Services, and Development teams. Your primary responsibilities include:
  
  

Data Analysis \& Management
  
  

Perform comprehensive analysis of complex financial data from private equity clients across multiple sources (General Ledger systems, Excel, proprietary/legacy platforms)
  
Map and transform client data to CapAssure data formats and database structures
  
Execute advanced data analysis using SQL, Excel, and Python to support business requirements and ad\-hoc requests
  
Extract, validate, and present actionable insights to Product and Client Service teams
  
  

System Configuration \& Database Management
  
  

Develop and maintain SQL scripts for system configuration updates based on client requirements
  
Stage and validate database changes that drive system behavior, calculations, and workflows
  
Manage configuration changes through development, QA, UAT, and Production environments
  
Ensure data integrity and quality through rigorous validation techniques
  
Work with modern data platforms including SQL Server and Databricks
  
  

Quality Assurance \& Testing
  
  

Design comprehensive test scenarios and plans for new features, functionality changes, and reporting enhancements
  
Execute functional, regression, and end\-to\-end acceptance testing
  
Create test data and develop test cases for accounting and financial workflows
  
Document test results in JIRA and Azure DevOps, compare against expected outcomes, and track defects through resolution
  
Validate that configuration changes produce intended impacts on data processing and system behavior
  
  

Client Support \& Onboarding
  
  

Support new client onboarding and ongoing configuration maintenance
  
Investigate and document client\-reported issues and system defects
  
Provide end\-user support for data analysis, reporting, and system change requests
  
Collaborate with development teams on client\-driven enhancements
  
  

SDLC \& Project Management
  
  

Contribute throughout the full Software Development Lifecycle from requirements analysis to production deployment
  
Track and manage client requests and deliverables through the Product pipeline using JIRA and Azure DevOps
  
Maintain documentation for system configurations, processes, and testing procedures
  
Work with shifting priorities and meet tight deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
  
  

**Required Qualifications:**  

Education \& Experience
  
  

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent additional experience)
  
5\-7 years of progressive experience in a business/systems analyst, data analyst, or related technical role
  
3\+ years of hands\-on experience with relational database management systems (RDBMS)
  
  

Technical Skills
  
  

**Database \& SQL Expertise:** Advanced proficiency in SQL coding, data normalization, and query optimization; strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server, T\-SQL, SSMS, SSRS, and SSIS
  
**Data Management:** Proven ability to handle large datasets using queries, imports, integration tools, and ETL processes
  
**Testing \& Project Management Tools:** Experience with JIRA and Azure DevOps for issue tracking, test management, and workflow automation

Company Profile:  

Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.  

Job Title: Insurance BA  

Position: Senior Software Engineer  

Experience: 4 \-10 Years  

Category: Software Development/ Engineering  

Shift: General  

Main location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai  

Position ID:
  

Employment Type: Full Time  

Education Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 4 years of relevant experience.  

Position Description  

We are looking for an experienced Insurance Business Analyst with strong Property \& Casualty (P\&C) Insurance domain knowledge. The ideal candidate will have excellent verbal and written communication skills and be confident in facilitating requirements discussions and working closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, Development, and QA teams.  

The candidate should be comfortable working independently, taking ownership of deliverables, proactively identifying issues, and ensuring clear communication and seamless handoffs between offshore and onshore teams.  

\#LI\-AS26

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

* Gather, analyze, document, and validate business and functional requirements.
* Facilitate requirement\-gathering sessions, workshops, and stakeholder discussions.
* Collaborate closely with Business Stakeholders, Product Owners, Developers, and QA teams.
* Translate business requirements into clear user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria.
* Support development and QA teams throughout the SDLC by clarifying requirements and resolving questions.
* Identify dependencies, risks, gaps, and issues and proactively communicate them to stakeholders.
* Ensure effective communication, documentation, and handoffs between offshore and onshore teams.
* Provide regular updates on progress, risks, and deliverables.
* Participate in requirement reviews, backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, and other Agile ceremonies.
* Maintain meaningful overlap with the onshore team, including availability until approximately 2:00 PM ET.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**


Must Have  

* Strong experience as a Business Analyst in the P\&C Insurance domain.
* Good understanding of P\&C insurance processes, products, and business workflows.
* Proven experience in requirements gathering, analysis, documentation, and validation.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Ability to confidently lead/facilitate requirement sessions and discussions.
* Experience working with Product Owners, Development, and QA teams.
* Experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, functional requirements, and process flows.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently and proactively manage assigned responsibilities.
* Willingness to maintain required overlap with the onshore team until approximately 2:00 PM ET.


Good to Have  

* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum delivery environment.
* Experience with insurance policy administration, claims, billing, or underwriting processes.
* Familiarity with insurance applications and end\-to\-end P\&C business processes.
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Visio, or similar BA/documentation tools.
* Experience working with distributed/onshore\-offshore delivery teams.
* Strong experience with process modeling and business workflow documentation.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineering Analyst
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

Optum is seeking a Data Engineer with health care experience to implement and manage cross\-domain, modular, flexible, scalable, secure, reliable and quality data solutions that transform data to support analytics and insight generation for our clients. The Data Engineer will implement, test, deploy, monitor, and maintain the delivery of data in a systematic method and will support a wide variety of analytical needs for our customers. The Director of Data Engineering will also partner with the broader OAS Analytics organization to harness the power of client data to facilitate analytical insight and will be responsible for building quality and efficiency into every project.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Support the full data engineering lifecycle including research, proof of concepts, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of data management solutions
* Utilize knowledge of various data management technologies to drive data engineering projects
* Lead data acquisition efforts to gather data from various structured or semi\-structured source systems of record to hydrate client data warehouse and power analytics across numerous health care domains
* Leverage combination of ETL/ELT methodologies to pull complex relational and dimensional data to support loading DataMart's and reporting aggregates
* Eliminate unwarranted complexity and unneeded interdependencies
* Detect data quality issues, identify root causes, implement fixes, and manage data audits to mitigate data challenges
* Implement, modify, and maintain data integration efforts that improve data efficiency, reliability, and value
* Leverage and facilitate the evolution of best practices for data acquisition, transformation, storage, and aggregation that solve current challenges and reduce the risk of future challenges
* Effectively create data transformations that address business requirements and other constraints
* Partner with the broader analytics organization to make recommendations for changes to data systems and the architecture of data platforms
* Support the implementation of a modern data framework that facilitates business intelligence reporting and advanced analytics
* Prepare high level design documents and detailed technical design documents with best practices to enable efficient data ingestion, transformation and data movement
* Leverage DevOps tools to enable code versioning and code deployment
* Leverage data pipeline monitoring tools to detect data integrity issues before they result into user visible outages or data quality issues
* Leverage processes and diagnostics tools to troubleshoot, maintain and optimize solutions and respond to customer and production issues
* Continuously support technical debt reduction, process transformation, and overall optimization
* Leverage and contribute to the evolution of standards for high quality documentation of data definitions, transformations, and processes to ensure data transparency, governance, and security
* Ensure that all solutions meet the business needs and requirements for security, scalability, and reliability
* AI User Responsibilities:
	+ Leverage enterprise\-approved AI tools to enhance productivity and innovation by streamlining workflows and automating repetitive tasks. Evaluate emerging trends to drive continuous improvement and strategic innovation
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree (preferably in information technology, engineering, math, computer science, analytics, engineering or other related field)

This role is central to translating complex business, financial, and operational data into clear, actionable insights that drive sound decision\-making across the organisation.
   

  

 This position is designed for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of business, finance, and technology, someone who can quickly grasp a business problem, dig into the underlying data and systems, and translate findings into tangible recommendations that stakeholders can act on. You will partner closely with cross\-functional teams to proactively identify opportunities, build robust and repeatable analytical processes, and tell the story behind the data with clarity and impact.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Partner with stakeholders across functions to understand business challenges and translate them into clear, well\-scoped analytical requirements.
* Deliver data\-driven business and financial insights that enable stakeholders to make sound, timely decisions.
* Proactively identify opportunities for process improvement and drive solution building from concept through delivery.
* Build robust, repeatable analytical processes that ensure a high standard of accuracy and timeliness in reporting and analysis.
* Lead and support projects that answer both strategic and tactical business questions.
* Quickly grasp ambiguous or complex business problems and translate them into structured, actionable outputs.
* Recommend approaches to problem\-solving grounded in facts, figures, and data, and communicate findings through compelling storytelling (the "why, what, how") to influence decisions.
* Integrate and manage the interplay between systems, technology, and people to support scalable analytical solutions.
* Navigate financial systems and understand data interdependencies across multiple platforms to ensure consistent, trustworthy analysis.
* Leverage AI and automation tools to streamline analysis, accelerate reporting, and surface insights faster.
* Operate with agility, adapting quickly as priorities, systems, or business needs evolve.


**About You**
**Core Competencies**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings clearly to varied audiences.
* Strong business acumen and understanding of organizational and functional issues and challenges.
* Proven ability to integrate and manage the relationship between systems, technology, and people.
* Highly organized, self\-directed, and able to manage multiple priorities with minimal oversight.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative, partnership\-oriented approach to working with stakeholders.
* Agility and adaptability in a fast\-changing business environment.
* Sharp analytical thinking, able to interpret varied inputs, build clear requirements, and partner effectively to solve business problems.
* Curiosity and comfort experimenting with new AI tools and technologies to improve ways of working.
* Finance and accounting knowledge is a strong plus.


**Skills \& Experience (Required)**
* Working knowledge of Varicent and SFDC.
* Proficiency with BI and automation tools such as Alteryx, Power BI, or SQL.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools to support analysis, reporting, or process automation.
* Solid understanding of financial systems and how data flows and interconnects across multiple platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to manage volume and maintain quality and accuracy under deadline pressure.
* Experience in Commission Process is an added advantage.
* 5\+ years of work experience in the above skills


**What Success Looks Like**
* Stakeholders consistently receive accurate, timely, data\-driven insights that inform key decisions.
* Analytical processes are robust, well\-documented, and scale with the needs of the business.
* Recurring issues and inefficiencies are proactively identified and addressed before they escalate.
* Cross\-functional partners view you as a trusted thought partner for solving business and financial problems.
* AI and automation tools are used effectively to improve speed, accuracy, and scalability of analysis.


**What’s in it For You?**
* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2\-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office\-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real\-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills\-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI\-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company\-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award\-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work\-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involve…

Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
   

  

**A Day in the Life**
 The ServiceNow function enables scalable, enterprise\-wide digital workflows that support business operations and service delivery across the organization. This team partners closely with business stakeholders, architects, developers, and delivery teams to optimize processes, improve user experiences, and implement ServiceNow solutions that align with business objectives.
   

  

 This position is based in Hyderabad, India and follows a Flex work model, combining in\-office collaboration with remote work. The role supports collaboration with global teams across multiple regions and functions.

* Foster innovation and exploration of new solutions

* Communicates with senior internal and external customers and vendors
* May provide guidance, coaching and training to other employees within job area.


**Required knowledge and experience:**
* BE or any computer Science education pedigree. 5\+ years of ServiceNow experience with demonstrated success in managing

* Preferred but not mandatory: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, Certified Implementation Specialist – IT Service Management (CIS \- ITSM), Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CIS – CSM) and/or Certified Implementation Specialist – Human Resources (CIS – HR)
* Strong coordination skills are essential for managing communication, expectations, and deliverables across all teams
* Proficiency in business and IT agile methodologies; experience with Scrum/Agile frameworks
* Hands\-on expertise in ServiceNow
* Familiarity with software engineering principles and design patterns
* Knowledge of software security practices
* High level of curiosity about emerging technologies
* Ability to advocate for out\-of\-the\-box ServiceNow solutions while aligning with business needs
* Experience in working with distributed, multicultural teams
* Strong analytical skills with a solution\-driven mindset
* Capability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey technical concepts clearly
* Initiative and proactive mindset
* Fluency in English


**Physical Job Requirements**
 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
   

  

 ‌
   

  

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**
 We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:
   

  

 Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.

jobs.description:
**About us:**  

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.  

  

Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.  

  

Target’s distinctive brand love is infused throughout its many physical locations by the Properties teams. We have a direct and positive impact on the real estate, design, construction and maintenance of our 2000\+ **stores, distribution centers and headquarters**. Target invests 75% of annual capital investment into Properties, and over half of the enterprise OpEx, leading to significant opportunity to impact outcomes for the business. We have an ambitious goal to launch hundreds of new stores over the next 10 years, with several hundred more remodels in stores, all driving new customers and incremental sales for Target.  

  

Are you ready to help strategically grow Target’s brand through leading\-edge design, development, construction and preservation? Can you effectively balance the efficiencies of a large\-design build company with the unique challenges and innovative solutions required by individual sites? Then take your place as a Product Manager on Target Properties Product team and help us make the most of Target’s physical footprint both in the U.S. and overseas.  

  

Product Teams at Target Corporation are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all product, technology and design work.  

  

As a Product Manager – GSCL Maintenance Operations, you will own the day\-to\-day product management for the work delivered in partnership with the Target in India Product Engineering team.  

  

This is a unique opportunity to help modernize Target’s Global Supply Chain Asset Management as part of a multi\-year transformation by moving from a highly customized legacy system to industry\-standard, out\-of\-the\-box Enterprise Asset Management capabilities for our Supply Chain Teams. The transformation will establish a more scalable and sustainable foundation for asset lifecycle visibility, standardized maintenance workflows, mobile execution, safety, workforce planning and scheduling, materials and inventory management, asset health, and predictive maintenance. This work will help reduce downtime, improve maintenance productivity, strengthen data quality and transparency, and enable better total\-cost\-of\-ownership decisions across Target’s supply chain network.  

  

Over the next several years, the team will establish the new Asset Management foundation and launch and scale across the network to eventually enable advanced asset\-health and predictive\-maintenance capabilities.  

  

As a Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will collaborate with your product team and key stakeholders to develop a plan and business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to build a strong knowledge of your product through product discovery to collect customer feedback and work to collect other relevant data points that explain the value and help you prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product. You will work in unison with engineers, UX designers, data scientists and business partners to deliver a product.  

  

You will be the “voice of the product” with your product team and stakeholders to ensure that their needs are met, and you will be responsible to maintain and refine the product backlog (create user stories \& acceptance criteria) while prioritizing the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders.  

  

You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles.  

  

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.  

  

**About you:*** Four\-year degree or equivalent experience
* 2\+ years of product management and/or equivalent domain experience
* Experience working in an agile environment (e.g. user stories, iterative development, scrum teams, sprints, personas, UI discovery and development)
* Strong facilitation skills that guide groups towards productive outcomes while maintaining a positive and collaborative atmosphere
* Demonstrated ability to bridge business and technical teams
* Curiosity with a passion for learning and contributing to a growth culture
* Product management experience in Asset Management/ Maintenance Management, or stores /properties experience preferred

jobs.description:
### **About Us**



With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e\-mobility a global reality.



Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once\-in\-a\-lifetime opportunity to create an all\-electric future and a trillion\-dollar market.



At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.



Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

### **Reports To**



Senior Product Manager


### **About the Role**



Payments are a core driver of ChargePoint's revenue, trust, and global scalability, accelerating our mission to make EV charging ubiquitous and convenient. As the Product Manager for Payments Operations \& Processor Management, you will take deep operational ownership of our global payment processing relationships, dispute workflows, and settlement reconciliation. This is a highly visible role offering direct impact on revenue integrity, margin optimization, and customer trust as you help power the world's leading EV charging network.


**What You Will Be Doing**  

  

Working in close partnership with our Campbell headquarters, you will ensure that processor relationships run smoothly, chargebacks are managed effectively, and settlement data is accurately reconciled. You will sit at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Security, and Operations to track payments performance and support strategic decision\-making. Over time, you will expand your strategic influence over processor selection, fraud prevention, and overall payments product direction, resolving complex processing issues alongside global Payments Engineering teams.


**What You Will Bring to ChargePoint (Responsibilities)**


* **Manage** the end\-to\-end chargeback lifecycle across global card brands and European acquirers, tracking cases, submitting representments, and monitoring dispute win rates and loss exposure.
* **Reconcile** processor settlement files against internal transaction records, identifying discrepancies, orphaned authorizations, and ensuring accurate funding and fee accounting.
* **Partner** with processors, gateways, and acquirers as the primary operational contact, driving issue resolution, contract renewals, and relationship health.
* **Analyze** and report on payments economics, including transaction fees, interchange costs, fraud losses, and chargeback exposure across currencies and regions.
* **Build** analytical models alongside Finance to support unit economics analysis, refund capacity, and multi\-currency cash flow projections.
* **Collaborate** with global Payments Engineering teams to triage, prioritize, and author technical tickets for payment processing defects and incident resolution.
* **Translate** complex regulatory, security, and financial constraints into clear product requirements and delivery plans for Engineering.
* **Support** fraud prevention strategies by monitoring key performance indicators, evaluating detection tooling, and ensuring PCI DSS compliance alongside Security and Risk teams.
* **Coordinate** cross\-functional execution of payments initiatives, clearly communicating risks, performance metrics, and trade\-offs to senior leadership.
* **Maintain** overlap hours with U.S. Pacific Time to facilitate seamless cross\-functional coordination, ticket grooming, and sprint planning.


**Requirements**


* 3\-5 years of experience in product management, payments operations, or financial operations with direct ownership of payment processing workflows and dispute management.
* Deep understanding of card networks, acquirers, tokenization, fraud typologies, chargeback lifecycles, and **PCI DSS compliance.**
* Demonstrated expertise in multi\-currency payment operations, particularly across European markets (EU/UK).
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and data manipulation at scale for financial analysis, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Proven ability to manage payment processor and vendor relationships, including issue escalation and deadline management.
* Experience collaborating with distributed engineering teams using ticketed workflows (e.g., Jira) to define and resolve product defects.
* Strong capability to operate autonomously as an individual contributor, influencing cross\-functional teams without direct authority.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* **Experience with PSPs and processors used in EV charging, IoT payments, mobility, or high\-volume SaaS platforms.**
* Hands\-on expertise parsing and reconciling processor settlement files, such as fixed\-width flat files or batch reports.
* Proficiency in scripting (Python, SQL, or similar) for data extraction, transformation, and reconciliation automation.
* Familiarity with machine learning\-driven fraud detection tools and chargeback representment workflows across major card networks.
* Track record of driving cost optimization or margin expansion initiatives.

Are you passionate about building products that solve real customer problems at massive scale? As a Sr. Product Manager \- Identity at Amazon, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for products that directly shape our abuse prevention and CX strategy by building robust customer identity solutions.  Hey there! We are a

 We're currently working with
 **3000\+ e\-commerce brands** 
 globally across 50\+ countries and are fortunate to have
 **raised $5\.5M\+** 
 along the journey with marquee investors like Sequoia Capital India, Kunal Shah, Gaurav Munjal \& more backing us.
 



  





 💡
 **Read more about our mission and the story of commerce here!** 




  





**Check out more about us here** 
 \- https://www.bitespeed.co/ and do read through our 200\+ odd 5\-star reviews to get a sense of what our customers say about us (we openly brag about this 😉).
 



  





 We've had some solid investors back us (making it easier for you to stalk us since you'd do this anyway).
 



  





**About the Role**




  





 Enterprise customers rarely come to us with neatly packaged problems. They come with a business goal, a messy process, a bunch of systems that don't talk to each other and a question:
 **"Can AI solve this?"** 




  





 We’re looking for an
 **AI Product Manager** 
 who can sit with our enterprise customers, understand these problems deeply and turn them into
 **AI\-powered solutions** 
 . You’ll operate at the intersection of strategy, technology, operations and customer conversations, working closely with our product and engineering teams to take solutions from an idea to something that actually works.
 



  





 This isn't a traditional PM role where you'll spend your days writing PRDs and moving tickets around. You'll be expected to get into the weeds, understand how things work, figure out what can be automated or solved with AI, and work backwards from the business outcome. You’ll have a front\-row seat to some of the most interesting AI use cases emerging in commerce.
 



  





**What you'll do**



* Work directly with
 **enterprise customers**

* Translate ambiguous business problems into
 **AI\-led solution strategies** 
 , figuring out what should be automated, augmented or redesigned.



  




* Own the solutioning process from

* Design workflows and solutions using

* Work with enterprise stakeholders to build business cases, define success metrics and communicate the expected impact of proposed solutions.



  




* Get hands\-on with the details when required, whether that's understanding APIs, data flows, system architecture or experimenting with AI tools and prototypes.



  




* Identify patterns across customer problems and feed those insights back into the
 **product roadmap** 
 , helping us decide what should become a scalable product rather than a one\-off solution.



  




* Build repeatable
 **solutioning playbooks, processes and operating mechanisms** 
 that help us solve enterprise problems faster as we scale.



  




* Partner with Sales and Customer Success on strategic accounts, helping them win, onboard and grow enterprise customers through better technical and AI\-led solutioning.



  




* Stay close to the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem and continuously experiment with new models, tools and approaches that could unlock better solutions for our customers.

* You enjoy sitting with a messy problem and figuring out
 **"how would we actually solve this?"** 
 rather than waiting for someone to hand you a requirements document.



  




* You have a
 **strong technical foundation** 
 and are comfortable understanding APIs, integrations, data flows and software systems. You don't necessarily need to be a full\-time engineer, but you should be technical enough to go deep when the problem demands it.



  




* You have
 **3\+ years of experience** 
 in product, solutions engineering, consulting, technology, strategy \& operations or a similar role where you've solved complex business problems.



  




* You are genuinely curious about
 **AI and LLMs** 
 and have experimented with AI tools, agents, workflows or applications beyond simply using ChatGPT to write emails.



  




* You are comfortable speaking to
 **enterprise customers and senior stakeholders** 
 , understanding their problems and explaining technical solutions in simple business language.



  




* You have strong business judgment and can distinguish between a problem that needs a fancy AI solution and one that just needs a better process.



  




* You are comfortable operating with
 **ambiguity and high ownership** 
 . There won't always be a playbook, and that's kind of the point.



  




* You care about outcomes more than job titles and enjoy moving between strategy, customer conversations and getting your hands dirty with execution.



  





**Salary and Location**




  





**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



  





**Expected CTC:** 
 We pay top of market for the right folks and also offer generous equity (ESOP) to everyone in the team
 



  





**Our Way Of Life**
 \- https://www.notion.so/bitespeed/Way\-Of\-Life\-At\-BiteSpeed\-44d9b9614d9641419da910189b1e9f8e.

**About noon** 




 We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East—fast, scalable, and deeply customer\-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, and we’re looking for a Logistics Product Manager who can help us move even faster.
 



 Noon’s fastest hyper\-local delivery platform, Noon Minutes, offers a localized assortment of FMCG \& grocery products with delivery within 15\-minutes. Currently live across the UAE and –\-Saudi Arabia, offering thousands of products to customers in record time.
 



 noon’s mission: Every door, every day.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




 The Logistics team owns the end\-to\-end product strategy and execution for the complete Delivery Associate (DA) experience, including DA Onboarding, Training, Support, and Order Delivery workflows across Noon Minutes. This team is the backbone of the last\-mile delivery network, operating across multiple countries with a large and growing fleet of DAs.
 



 As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for driving strategic goals with millions in cost savings, DA satisfaction and sentiment, and the Core Order Delivery journey. You will own the logistics product area and be accountable for measurable improvements.
 



 This is a global role requiring cross\-regional coordination across all regions where the Noon Minutes program is established or will be established. It demands a dual operating mode:
 


* **Rapid experimentation and iterations** 
 \- drive improvements through quick iteration cycles and data\-driven decision\-making.
* **Long\-term vision**

 You will serve as the
 **Voice of the DAs** 
 , generalizing requirements from diverse DA personas across regions and use cases, working from needs to solutions. You are expected to engage directly with DAs, on\-ground support teams, and operational health monitoring to gain insight that distinguishes between surface\-level requests and the underlying problems that truly matter.
 



 We are seeking a Product Manager with deep expertise and high agency who takes the lead on driving initiatives while seeking direction when needed. **Who will excel?** 



* We’re looking for people with high standards, who understand that hard work matters.

* We need people with the courage to be fiercely original.

Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s supporting our songwriters, ensuring we provide the right royalty data to global partners, or helping our creative teams use the latest AI tools to discover new talent, technology plays an invaluable role in our success. Product Managers help turn vision into reality.
   

  

 We are looking for a Product Manager to partner with a local in\-person engineering team in Bengaluru focused on music distribution. Distribution is the vital link between music creation and a fan’s headphones, ensuring our music reaches platforms like Spotify and YouTube globally while protecting the complex rights that ensure our artists get paid. You will be a "user\-first" thinker who is responsible for a portfolio of features and products, navigating the high\-stakes world of global rights, supply chain automation, and high\-scale digital delivery.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Continuous Discovery: Build deep empathy for our labels, operations teams, and global partners by maintaining a constant dialogue with them. Uncover their underlying pain points, ensuring that every solution we build truly solves their problems and makes their daily workflows more seamless.

* Product Trio Collaboration: Work in a "Product Trio" alongside Engineering and Design to solve complex problems, resolving trade\-offs and tackling risks.

jobs.title: Product Manager II ( Poster )
jobs.description:
**About Lokal**
 In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier\-2/3 towns weren't really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they'd come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.
   

  

 This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place \& one app \- local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight—when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies \& marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
   

  

**Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: To connect Tier\-2/3\+ India to the knowledge, opportunities, tools, and experts they've always deserved.**
**We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:**
* Emotional Well\-being \& Peer Support \- safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt \& Eaze)
* Astrology \& Guidance \- instant access to trusted Astrologers (AstroLokal)
* Edutainment \& Skill Learning \- practical skills in regional languages (GyanTV)
* Matrimonial Matchmaking \- hyperlocal, compatibility\-first search (Lokal Matrimony)
* Agri Consulting \- farmer\-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* Local Jobs \- blue\- and grey\-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
* Social \& Community \- Place to find \& post social updates (Lokal app)


 Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local\-language internet \+ deep Bharat insight \+ AI. When someone opens a product we've built, they don't wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for. This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a WhatsApp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.
   

  

 We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat. We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.
   

  

**Requirements**
 About Posters
   

  

 Posters is Lokal's visual expression engine. Users in Bharat love sharing daily greetings, festival wishes, political support, and social updates with their networks. Posters empowers our audience to effortlessly create, personalize, and share high
   

  

 quality visual content in their own regional languages. By providing highly relevant, easy\-to\-use templates for every occasion, we are building a sticky daily habit that drives immense engagement, viral growth, and social sharing across the Lokal ecosystem.
   

  

 What You'll Own
   

  

* End\-to\-End Product Ownership: Full ownership of the Posters product area, measured by core business outcomes (Daily


 Active Users, shares per user, template conversion rates, retention, and monetization strategies), rather than just feature
   

  

 output.
   

  

* Growth \& Virality Funnels: Tight collaboration with content and marketing teams. The funnel starts with surfacing highly


 relevant regional templates and ends with a user proudly sharing them on their WhatsApp status. You connect content
   

  

 creation to seamless social delivery.
   

  

* Deep Data Analytics: Read user sharing behavior from data, run 2nd and 3rd level digging to find the real drivers of


 virality, and know when to stop over\-analyzing and just ship a new creator tool or feed update.
   

  

* Personalization \& Discovery: Ship MVPs fast (category\-specific templates, localized festival feeds), and build the business


 case for ML\-driven personalization to surface the perfect poster for every user, every day.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
* Scale: Experience on high\-MAU, consumer\-facing products at scale (ideally in content, social, or creative tools)
* User Empathy: You can define sharp personas, deeply understand jobs\-to\-be\-done (e.g., "I want to look knowledgeable


 and updated on my WhatsApp status"), and have the toolkit to build that understanding quickly in a new language market.
   

  

* Agility \& Rigor: Comfort balancing rigor and speed. You practice A/B discipline without falling into analysis paralysis
* Domain Expertise: A proven method for acquiring domain understanding fast through user interviews, funnel teardowns,


 churn research, and competitive analysis of content\-sharing platforms.
   

  

 Nice to Have
   

  

* Vernacular or India\-specific consumer product experience
* Experience with social sharing loops, viral growth, or content\-creation and template\-driven products

**Job Description:**
****Product Manager, AI\-Powered Network Observability \- Broadcom****
****About Broadcom:****
 Broadcom Inc. is a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions. Broadcom’s category\-leading product portfolio serves critical markets including data center, networking, enterprise software, broadband, wireless, and storage.
   

  

****About Broadcom Network Observability:****
 Broadcom Network Observability delivers cutting\-edge solutions for network monitoring, analysis, and automation, empowering enterprises to optimize network performance and ensure business continuity. We are at the forefront of leveraging AI and machine learning to revolutionize network observability and provide unparalleled insights.

 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Product Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and execution of our AI\-powered network observability solutions within Broadcom Network Observability. This role will focus on leveraging artificial intelligence and machine learning to enhance network visibility, automate anomaly detection, and provide actionable insights for our customers. You will be responsible for defining the product roadmap, working closely with engineering, design, and marketing teams, and ensuring the successful delivery of innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of our enterprise customers.

+ Define and execute the product vision and roadmap for AI\-powered network observability solutions.
+ Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and inform product strategy.

* Customer Engagement and Advocacy:

* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.
* Experience with cloud based technologies and SaaS product delivery.
* Experience with Network performance Monitoring and Diagnostics (NPMD) solutions.
* Familiarity with data visualization and analytics tools.


****Preferred Qualifications:****
* Experience with large\-scale data processing and analysis.
* Knowledge of cloud\-native technologies and microservices architectures.
* Experience with Agile development methodologies.
* Experience in the networking industry.


****Benefits:****
 Broadcom offers a competitive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off. We are committed to fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment where employees can thrive and make a meaningful impact.
   

  

****To Apply:****
 Please submit your resume and cover letter online. We look forward to hearing from you!

**About Glean**
 Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full\-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business \- without vendor lock\-in or costly implementation cycles.
   

  

 At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context\-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities \- AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real\-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
   

  

 Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025\), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026\), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50\+ industries and 1,000\+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI\-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
   

  

 If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more \- deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Glean’s Connectors PM, you’ll expand Glean’s connectors library, improve and deepen our existing product integrations, and improve our Indexing API and custom connector capabilities.
   

  

**You Will**
* Spending a lot of time with our customers to deeply understand their knowledge needs
* Developing key parts of our product roadmap, marrying customers’ needs with our product vision
* Empowering your team by giving context, setting direction, and building alignment
* Driving customer\-focused decisions, clear prioritization, and efficient execution
* Coordinating cross\-functionally with with leadership, go\-to\-market teams, and other key stakeholders across the company
* Building processes that will scale as our team and company go through rapid growth


**About You**
* You have 6\+ years of experience as a product manager at a B2B SaaS company. Experience working on collaboration, productivity, or ML/ranking tools is a plus.
* You have a strong technical background and excel at analytical thinking
* You are an excellent written and verbal communicator
* You have a proven track record of taking ownership, taking initiative, and delivering results
* You collaborate effectively with cross\-functional partners
* You have a learning and growth mindset
* You are mission\-first and understand that your success is measured by your product and team’s success


**Location:**
* This role is hybrid (3 days a week in our Bangalore office)


**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Strong technical writing and documentation development skills.

The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next\-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Location:
   

  

 Bangalore,IND
   

  

 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
   

  

 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

**As the Technical Product Owner / SAP Finance functional lead,** 
 you will be responsible to improve / enhance Finance solutions across RTR, PTP, General Ledger, Consolidations, Accounts Payable, and Fixed Assets. You will connect Finance and Technology providing seamless integration and reliable functionalities that are compliant and aligned with enterprise standards.
