* Drive Finance systems roadmap and prioritize the backlog based on business value, controls, and enterprise standards.
* Partner with Finance, Technology, Architecture, and delivery teams to define requirements, user stories, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and test plans.
* Lead planning, governance, testing, release readiness, and production deployment across Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery models.
* Guide the delivery of SAP enhancements, interfaces, reports, reconciliations, and lasting fixes for system, process, and data issues.
* Keep stakeholders informed of priorities, risks, dependencies, decisions, and delivery status.


 Skills You’ll Need
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of SAP S/4 or ECC 6\.0 FI/CO experience in support, enhancements, projects, and continuous improvement, including New GL or related Finance integration.
* Strong SAP Finance functional and configuration knowledge, with depth in General Ledger, Accounts Payable, or Fixed Assets and working knowledge of related FI/CO areas.
* General Ledger and close experience with financial reporting, profit centers, currency revaluation and translation, document splitting, non\-leading ledgers, substitutions and validations, account determination, settlements, intercompany, and consolidations.
* Accounts Payable and PTP experience with FI\-AP, MM\-LIV, vendor master, payments, bank interfaces, EBS, tax, ERS, VMI, intercompany stock transfers, purchasing, goods receipts, and account determination.
* Fixed Assets experience with capital expenditures, asset classes, depreciation, CIP capitalization, settlements, asset transfers and lifecycle, legacy transfers, FA\-GL reconciliation, and period or year\-end close.
* Experience preparing functional specifications and delivering custom programs, reports, interfaces, or enhancements with technical teams.
* Experience with test planning, end\-to\-end testing, change control, and production deployment.
* Strong analytical, organization, and delivery skills, with the ability to manage priorities and drive work to closure independently.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for working with Finance, business, IT, and implementation partners.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of SAP S/4 MDG for GL, cost center, or vendor master data, and familiarity with Dynpro forms.
* Experience with BlackLine, SEM BCS, EC\-CS, or other close, reconciliation, and consolidation tools.
* Experience with third\-party applications such as Concur, Taulia, Fieldglass, Sovos, or Taxware.
* Experience with EDI, IDoc, ALE, BAPI, RFC, connectors, and BI/BO reporting.
* Cross\-functional knowledge of SAP S/4 or ECC FI\-GL, FI\-AP, FI\-AA, Purchasing, AR, Project Systems, Internal Orders, or SAP HR and vendor master integration.
* Experience with full lifecycle implementations, ERP transformation, SAP upgrades, New Asset Accounting, or S/4HANA Finance.
* Knowledge of SAP security and access troubleshooting; ABAP debugging skills are a plus.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Applications (Excel, Word, Projects, Powerpoint)
* Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, or related field; SAP S/4 Finance certification is preferred.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a Product Owner \- Manager, you will lead the charge in developing innovative software solutions and driving product innovation to meet the evolving needs of clients. Within our Advisory practice, you will be at the intersection of business, user experience, and technology, managing commercial and internal products to validate they meet market demands and drive business growth. Your role will encompass the entire product lifecycle, from definition and planning through production, release, and end\-of\-life, including commercialization and go\-to\-market planning.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will enhance your leadership style by motivating, developing, and inspiring others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You will embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. You will address conflicts or issues, engage in difficult conversations with clients and team members, and uphold professional and technical standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Leading product management initiatives from concept through to end\-of\-life, confirming alignment with market demands and business growth
* Guiding cross\-functional teams in the development and execution of product strategies using Agile Methodology
* Overseeing the planning, budgeting, and execution of product development projects to meet client expectations
* Collaborating with business and technology stakeholders to identify and address user experience challenges
* Managing the lifecycle of software products, including modifications, upgrades, and maintenance
* Driving commercialization and go\-to\-market strategies for commercial products
* Mentoring team members to enhance their skills and encourage professional growth
* Utilizing software product management techniques to optimize product performance and user satisfaction
* Analyzing system components to identify linkages and interactions for improved product solutions
* Engaging in constructive discussions with clients and stakeholders to resolve conflicts and issues


 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 4 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Business Analytics, Computer and Information Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Programming, Design, Engineering, Engineering and Business, Industrial Design, Management Information Systems, Mechanical Engineering, Statistics
* Demonstrating proficiency in Agile Methodology and Product Management
* Excelling in communication and conflict resolution within teams
* Utilizing skills in software product management to drive innovation
* Leading product development initiatives with a focus on client satisfaction
* Mentoring team members to enhance their professional growth
* Analyzing complex systems to identify improvement opportunities

Senior Associate, Business Analysis
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and relational databases—cutting\-edge technology in 1988! Fast\-forward to today, and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data\-driven decision\-making.


Today, we are a high\-tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a nationally recognized brand all in one, impacting over 65 million customer accounts. Still founder\-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt, and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry, and each other.


As a Senior Associate at Capital One, you will apply your analytical skills to major company challenges. You'll team with world\-class professionals to develop and test strategies that ultimately impact how the company manages customer friction and resolution. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibility, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.

**Team Description**


Welcome to Customer Navigator. We are the central nervous system for enterprise\-wide customer resolution, serving as the one\-stop engine to resolve complaints across all Capital One Lines of Business (LOBs).


We are not just improving processes; we are completely re\-engineering how we understand and resolve customer friction. Our platform aggregates massive amounts of fragmented enterprise data, mapping it into a seamless, chronological "journey format" for our agents. By layering advanced Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning over this data within an easily understandable User Interface (UI), we empower our teams to resolve complex customer issues with unprecedented speed, empathy, and accuracy.

* **Execution Focus:** Display an intense focus on achieving both short\- and long\-term goals, helping drive business intent and product adoption in an uncertain and fluid environment.

**The ideal candidate is:**

* **Inquisitive:** You thrive on solving big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
* **Technical:** You’re comfortable navigating complex analytical solutions and have hands\-on experience conducting business analyses using modern data tools.
* **Innovative:** You continually are on the lookout for novel approaches, solutions, and emerging technologies (like GenAI) to solve business problems and improve the customer experience.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Math, Engineering, Economics, Econometrics, Finance or Operations Research).
* At least 2 years of professional work experience in analytics, business analysis or data\-driven product management.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 3\+ years of experience with Python, R, SQL and relational databases.
* Experience in the financial services industry, specifically dealing with cross\-LOB operations, customer experience or complaint resolution.
* Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy, and proficiency in key econometric and statistical techniques (such as hypothesis testing, regression modeling, etc.).
* Experience translating ambiguous business problems into clear analytical questions and tangible product features.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.

The Company
  
At Trane Technologies, we Challenge the Possible. Our brands — including Trane® and Thermo King® — create access to cooling and comfort in buildings and homes, transport and protect food and perishables, connect customers to elevated performance with less environmental impact, dramatically reduce energy demands and carbon emissions, and innovate with a better world in mind. Trane Technologies is seeking a Data Engineering Analyst to join our ISC Data Architecture \& Governance team based in Bangalore, India. This is a hands\-on role for a candidate who can build scalable data engineering pipelines, analyze legacy systems and workflows, and help modernize our data landscape on Google Cloud Platform.
  
In this role, you will be responsible for ingesting data from internal and external sources into our enterprise data lake, with a strong focus on the bronze layer of a medallion architecture. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data analysts, and technical teams to gather requirements, clarify business logic, support testing, and design practical solutions that improve reliability, usability, and scalability.
  
The ideal candidate combines strong technical data engineering skills with the ability to work independently, determine next steps, and communicate effectively with customers and stakeholders throughout the solution lifecycle.

* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, integrations, and ETL/ELT workflows on Google Cloud Platform using BigQuery, Airflow, and Cloud Data Fusion.

* Analyze legacy systems, databases, workflows, and transformation logic to understand current\-state processes, dependencies, and opportunities for modernization.
* Document current\-state data flows and system behavior and develop recommendations for process improvement, architecture simplification, and legacy\-to\-cloud modernization.
* Use strong SQL skills to analyze source data, validate transformations, understand embedded business logic, and support data analysts with trusted datasets.
* Partner with business stakeholders and internal customers to gather requirements, clarify needs, support testing, and translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.

* Apply data quality, governance, documentation, and security standards while continuously improving pipeline reliability, scalability, and performance.


Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience in data engineering, cloud data platforms, data integration, or related roles.
* Hands\-on experience building data pipelines in Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong working knowledge of BigQuery, Cloud Composer, and Cloud Data Fusion.
* Strong SQL skills, including the ability to analyze legacy systems, investigate data issues, validate transformations, and support analytics users.
* Knowledge of Python and Data Engineering packages such as PySpark and Airflow
* Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and semi\-structured data.
* Familiarity with data lake concepts and medallion architecture, especially bronze\-layer ingestion patterns.
* Familiarity with data governance, metadata, lineage, and data quality practices.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, communication, and self\-management skills.
* Experience working in cross\-functional or global teams.
* Google Cloud certifications are a plus.


What You Will Bring
  
  

* A hands\-on engineering mindset with the ability to move from analysis to design to delivery.
* Strong curiosity and comfort working through ambiguity in legacy environments.
* The ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
* A proactive, self\-directed approach to identifying priorities and driving work forward.

Bangalore, Karnataka, IN

Do you want to play a key role in the Warehouse 4\.0 journey in Novo Nordisk by implementing the SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) on the latest S/4 HANA technology as warehouse management and control system? Are you seeking an opportunity to drive IT solution implementation and engage with stakeholders across IT, the Manufacturing Sites and the Supply Chain Organisation? If so, the position as SAP EWM Advanced Business Analyst can be the right fit for putting your expertise to work while at the same time making a difference for patients living with diabetes. Apply now!
  
  

Your new role
  
  

As Senior Business Analyst specializing in SAP EWM, you'll be instrumental in Novo Nordisk's Warehouse 4\.0 program – our transformative initiative to automate warehouse operations using modern technology including mobile robots (AGVs/AMRs) and shuttle systems. SAP EWM is the key enabler of this digitalisation journey, and you'll work within an agile team deploying this solution across our global manufacturing network.

Contributing to the design and implementation of the standard SAP EWM template to support required business processes across strategic locations worldwide

Ensuring seamless integration of SAP EWM with other SAP modules and external systems throughout the supply chain
  
Guiding and supporting the existing team in troubleshooting, system configuration, operations and incident management and following best practices
  
Engaging in dialogue with WareX colleagues across the supply chain to ensure delivered solutions align with business requirements
  
Collaborating closely with diverse stakeholders in IT and line of business, including Manufacturing Sites, Supply Chain IT and external vendors
  
Ensuring high\-quality deliverables that adhere to GxP requirements and pharmaceutical standards

Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal

WareX (SAP Warehouse Management Solutions) is a unit responsible for the operation, maintenance, support and development of warehouse systems.
